qa.question: I summon a Golden Beast Tamer and Nitro Juggler with Silver Thorn Dragon Tamer, Luquier's Fanfare ability. If I banish a Pale Moon follower that costs 2 or less with Nitro Juggler's Fanfare ability, can I summon it with Golden Beast Tamer's Fanfare ability?

While there's a Goddess of the Half Moon, Tsukuyomi and Goddess of the Crescent Moon, Tsukuyomi in your cemetery, this follower has Storm.
{icon_fanfare|[fanfare]} You may summon an Oracle Think Tank follower that costs 4 or less from your hand.

qa.title: Q1456 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: When attacking using a follower with Twin Drive, if I reveal a Trigger with the first drive check, do I resolve the Trigger before or after performing the second drive check?
qa.answer: You resolve the Trigger first. For example, if you reveal and resolve a Draw Trigger with the first drive check, you will draw a card, put the resolved Trigger into your cemetery, then perform the second drive check. If you choose not to resolve the Trigger, you will put it on the bottom of your deck, then perform the second drive check.

qa.title: Q1448 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: Can I play Moon and Sun to search my deck for this follower?
qa.answer: No. You also can't play Moon and Sun's activated ability to select this follower in your cemetery.

qa.title: Q1402 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: Do I resolve Twin Drive before an opponent can play cards and abilities with Quick?
qa.answer: Yes. When attacking, all abilities that are triggered must be resolved before non-active players can play cards and abilities with Quick.

qa.title: Q1435 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: When do "when(ever) you drive check a Trigger" abilities trigger?
qa.answer: They trigger when you resolve a Trigger revealed by a drive check. If you play a follower's Twin Drive ability and resolve 2 Triggers, any "when(ever) you drive check a Trigger" abilities trigger twice and become pending. Then, after you finish resolving the Twin Drive ability, you resolve any pending abilities.
